```{r}
## Studi Kasus 1: ARCH/GARCH saham BUMI (energi/batu bara)
# Muhammad Hafidz Ar Rasyid Hutagalung
# 222413683
# 2KS3

library(readxl)
library(xts)
library(urca)
library(forecast)
library(lmtest)
library(nortsTest)
library(rugarch)
library(FinTS)

bumi_raw<- read_excel("D:/Tugas/S4/ARW/BUMI_Harian.xlsx")
print(head(bumi_raw))

cat("Hari bervolume nol (suspensi/libur):", sum(bumi_raw$Volume == 0), "dari", nrow(bumi_raw), "\n")
# Hari tanpa transaksi (mis. masa suspensi) dikeluarkan agar return tidak
# semu (harga "diam" karena tidak diperdagangkan, bukan karena stabil).

tgl <- as.Date(bumi_raw$Date)
harga <- xts(bumi_raw$Close, order.by = tgl)
harga <- harga[bumi_raw$Volume > 0, ]
colnames(harga) <- "Close"

# EKSPLORASI DATA 
harga_explor <- harga[order(index(harga))]

# Informasi umum
cat("Periode data        :", format(start(harga_explor)), "s.d.", format(end(harga_explor)), "\n")
cat("Jumlah observasi    :", nrow(harga_explor), "\n")
cat("Jumlah data hilang  :", sum(is.na(harga_explor)), "\n\n")

# Harga tertinggi, terendah, dan rata-rata
nilai <- as.numeric(harga_explor)
tgl   <- index(harga_explor)

pos_max <- which.max(nilai)
pos_min <- which.min(nilai)

# Ringkasan dalam bentuk tabel
ringkasan_harga <- data.frame(
  Ukuran  = c("Tertinggi", "Terendah", "Rata-rata"),
  Harga   = c(nilai[pos_max], nilai[pos_min], round(mean(nilai, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
  Tanggal = c(format(tgl[pos_max]), format(tgl[pos_min]), "-")
)
ringkasan_harga

ringkasan_lengkap <- data.frame(
  Ukuran = c("Min", "Kuartil 1", "Median", "Rata-rata", "Kuartil 3", "Max", "Simpangan baku"),
  Nilai  = c(min(nilai), quantile(nilai, 0.25), median(nilai), mean(nilai),
             quantile(nilai, 0.75), max(nilai), sd(nilai)),
  row.names = NULL
)
ringkasan_lengkap

# Plot 
plot(
  harga,
  main = "Harga Penutupan Saham BUMI",
  ylab = "Rupiah"
)


## Return log harian (%)
ret <- 100 * diff(log(harga))
ret <- na.omit(ret)
colnames(ret) <- "Return"

cat("Proporsi return = 0:", mean(coredata(ret == 0)), "\n")
cat("Jumlah observasi return :", length(ret), "\n")
summary(ret)
sd(ret)

# Plot Return
plot(ret, main = "Return Harian BUMI", ylab = "Return (%)")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey")

# Stasioneritas
# Data awal 
adf_harga_none <- ur.df(harga, type = "none", selectlags = "AIC")
summary(adf_harga_none)
adf_harga_drift <- ur.df(harga, type = "drift", selectlags = "AIC")
summary(adf_harga_drift)
adf_harga_trend <- ur.df(harga, type = "trend", selectlags = "AIC")
summary(adf_harga_trend)

# Data return 
adf_ret_none <- ur.df(ret, type = "none", selectlags = "AIC")
summary(adf_ret_none)
adf_ret_drift <- ur.df(ret, type = "drift", selectlags = "AIC")
summary(adf_ret_drift)
adf_ret_trend <- ur.df(ret, type = "trend", selectlags = "AIC")
summary(adf_ret_trend)


# Efek ARCH
ret_num <- as.numeric(ret)
ret_num2 <- ret_num^2

Box.test(ret_num, lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(ret_num2, lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(ret_num, lag = 24, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(ret_num2, lag = 24, type = "Ljung-Box")

ArchTest(ret_num,   lags = 12)
ArchTest(ret_num,   lags = 24)


# ACF PACF
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
acf(as.numeric(ret),  lag.max = 40, main = "ACF Return")
pacf(as.numeric(ret), lag.max = 40, main = "PACF Return")

acf_vals <- acf(as.numeric(ret), lag.max = 40, plot = FALSE)
hasil_acf <- data.frame(
  Lag = 1:40,
  ACF = round(acf_vals$acf[-1], 4)
)
hasil_acf$Signifikan <- ifelse(
  abs(hasil_acf$ACF) > 1.96/sqrt(length(ret)), "Ya", "Tidak"
)
print(hasil_acf)

pacf_vals <- pacf(as.numeric(ret), lag.max = 40, plot = FALSE)
hasil_pacf <- data.frame(Lag = 1:40, PACF = round(pacf_vals$acf, 4))
hasil_pacf$Signifikan <- ifelse(abs(hasil_pacf$PACF) > 1.96/sqrt(length(ret)), "Ya", "Tidak")
print(hasil_pacf)


# Kandidat model
# Metode auto arima
fit_auto <- auto.arima(
  ret_num, 
  d = 0,                  # Data sudah stasioner
  max.p = 5, 
  max.q = 5, 
  stationary = TRUE, 
  seasonal = FALSE, 
  ic = "aic", 
  stepwise = FALSE,       
  approximation = FALSE
)

summary(fit_auto)

# Uji White Noise Residual Auto ARIMA
lb_auto <- Box.test(residuals(fit_auto), lag = 24, type = "Ljung-Box")

df_auto <- data.frame(
  Metode     = "Auto ARIMA",
  Model      = paste0("ARMA(", fit_auto$arma[1], ",", fit_auto$arma[2], ")"),
  AIC        = round(AIC(fit_auto), 4),
  BIC        = round(BIC(fit_auto), 4),
  LogLik     = round(as.numeric(logLik(fit_auto)), 2),
  LB_pvalue  = round(lb_auto$p.value, 4),
  WhiteNoise = ifelse(lb_auto$p.value > 0.05, "Ya", "Tidak")
)

# Metode Grid Search Manuak
# Grid kombinasi lag yang teridentifikasi signifikan di ACF/PACF
kandidat <- expand.grid(
  p = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5),
  q = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5)
)

hasil_manual <- data.frame()
models_manual <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(kandidat)) {
  p_i <- kandidat$p[i]
  q_i <- kandidat$q[i]
  nama <- paste0("ARMA(", p_i, ",", q_i, ")")
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    Arima(ret_num, order = c(p_i, 0, q_i), include.mean = TRUE, method = "ML"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (!is.null(fit)) {
    lb <- Box.test(residuals(fit), lag = 24, type = "Ljung-Box")
    
    hasil_manual <- rbind(hasil_manual, data.frame(
      Metode     = "Grid Search",
      Model      = nama,
      AIC        = round(AIC(fit), 4),
      BIC        = round(BIC(fit), 4),
      LogLik     = round(as.numeric(logLik(fit)), 2),
      LB_pvalue  = round(lb$p.value, 4),
      WhiteNoise = ifelse(lb$p.value > 0.05, "Ya", "Tidak")
    ))
    models_manual[[nama]] <- fit
  }
}


# Ambil Model Terbaik Grid Search (AIC Terkecil)
hasil_manual_sorted <- hasil_manual[order(hasil_manual$AIC), ]
best_manual_row     <- hasil_manual_sorted[1, ]

# Auto arima VS Grid search
tabel_komparasi <- rbind(df_auto, best_manual_row)
rownames(tabel_komparasi) <- NULL
print(tabel_komparasi)

cat("\n--- Top 5 Model Grid Search Manual ---\n")
print(head(hasil_manual_sorted, 5))



res_arma <- residuals(fit_auto)

# Ljung-Box pada residual
Box.test(res_arma,  lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(res_arma,  lag = 24, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Ljung-Box pada residual kuadrat
Box.test(res_arma^2, lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(res_arma^2, lag = 24, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Uji ARCH-LM
ArchTest(res_arma, lags = 12)
ArchTest(res_arma, lags = 24)

# Pemodelan GARCH
spec_garch <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model     = list(model = "sGARCH", garchOrder = c(1,1)),
  mean.model         = list(armaOrder = c(3,2), include.mean = TRUE),  # tetap 3,2 -- ini benar
  distribution.model = "norm" 
)
fit_garch <- ugarchfit(spec = spec_garch, data = ret, solver = "hybrid")
show(fit_garch)

spec_gjr <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(model = "gjrGARCH", garchOrder = c(1,1)),
  mean.model     = list(armaOrder = c(3,2), include.mean = TRUE),
  distribution.model = "norm"
)
fit_gjr <- ugarchfit(spec_gjr, data = ret, solver = "hybrid")
show(fit_gjr)

spec_igarch <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(model = "iGARCH", garchOrder = c(1,1)),
  mean.model     = list(armaOrder = c(3,2), include.mean = TRUE),
  distribution.model = "norm")
fit_igarch <- ugarchfit(spec_igarch, data = ret, solver = "hybrid")
show(fit_igarch)

infocriteria(fit_garch)
infocriteria(fit_gjr)
infocriteria(fit_igarch)  

# Plot Volatilitas Kondisional (Conditional Volatility)
plot(fit_gjr, which = 3)

# Plot News Impact Curve (Respons volatilitas terhadap bad vs good news)
plot(fit_gjr, which = 12)

fit_final <- fit_gjr
z <- residuals(fit_final, standardize = TRUE)
z <- as.numeric(z)
z <- na.omit(z)

Box.test(
  z,
  lag = 12,
  type = "Ljung-Box"
)

Box.test(
  z,
  lag = 24,
  type = "Ljung-Box"
)

Box.test(
  z^2,
  lag = 12,
  type = "Ljung-Box"
)

Box.test(
  z^2,
  lag = 24,
  type = "Ljung-Box"
)


ArchTest(
  z,
  lags = 12
)
ArchTest(
  z,
  lags = 24
)


plot(z, type = "l",
     main = "Standardized Residuals",
     ylab = "Residual",
     xlab = "Observation")

acf(z,
    main = "ACF Standardized Residuals")

acf(z^2,
    main = "ACF Squared Standardized Residuals")


forecast_final <- ugarchforecast(
  fit_final,
  n.ahead = 10
)

show(forecast_final)
fitted(forecast_final)
sigma(forecast_final)


plot(
  sigma(forecast_final),
  main = "Forecast Conditional Volatility",
  ylab = "Volatility",
  xlab = "Forecast Horizon"
)
plot(
  fitted(forecast_final),
  main = "Forecast Return",
  ylab = "Return",
  xlab = "Forecast Horizon"
)
```
